history.notes: 3D pictures can turn on their own: ROTATE under SPEED. ROOM now works out real room acoustics - reflections off the walls, bass piling up in corners and the reverb time - for an ordinary room, a treated studio or outdoors, with the room's furniture and treatment drawn in. New ISSUES markers on the spectrum: resonances, mud and harshness. BALANCE shows how much each range loses in mono. All-new CHORD and KEY detection with an AI model: 170 kinds of chords, shown within half a second. Right click to hear hints.

IN TARGET / OUTSIDE now work together with VOCAL / INST: right click both to hear only the part of the voice (or the instruments) inside or outside the target. The BUY button opens the Visualize page directly.

New MONITOR picture: what is lost when the mix is played in mono, a target shape and a score - IN TARGET / OUTSIDE to see (left click) or hear (right click) only those parts. IMAGE redrawn: each sound a cloud - loud sounds in front, echo and reverb trail behind, wide sounds spread out. CYLINDER is now called VECTOR. A short tour on first start (the ? in Settings shows it again) and RETURN ALL TO DEFAULT in Settings. Loudness: the big number is the whole song. 3D pictures turn freely by dragging, the mouse wheel or the arrow keys. Smaller buttons, faster drawing and less delay.

VOCAL / INST: see (left click) or hear (right click) only the voice or only the instruments, separated by AI - the AI files download once, the first time you use it. STEMS colours: every graph in the colour of its instrument. New width pictures IMAGE and HEAT. COLOR choices and a CPU meter at the top. Lighter, smoother drawing.
